instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: There are eight planets in our solar ((system)).
atoms.finishSound: There are eight planets in our solar system.

atoms.b: She studies hard to ((achieve)) the best mark possible.
atoms.finishSound: She studies hard to achieve the best mark possible.

atoms.b: They bought their new house for a ((bargain)).
atoms.finishSound: They bought their new house for a bargain.
What is your favourite foreign food?

atoms.b: He felt ((awkward)) about what he had said.
atoms.finishSound: He felt awkward about what he had said.
